criteria.requirement: Add babel.dates.format_duration(delta, *, units=("day","hour","minute","second"), max_parts=None, length="long", locale=None). Accept nonnegative finite seconds or timedelta, decompose by explicit strictly descending unique week/day/hour/minute/second units, preserve fractional remainder in the smallest unit, omit zero components and render zero in the smallest unit. Use existing format_unit pluralization and CLDR unit list styles, falling back to standard list style for incomplete unit list patterns. max_parts truncates nonzero components without rounding. Reject calendar months/years, invalid order, negative/nonfinite values and invalid part counts; preserve format_timedelta.
